answer: Unannounced memory-hard roll calls. At a random minute each epoch every seat must solve an Argon2 puzzle needing 16 GB of RAM in one thread within 30 s. Puzzles can't time-share, so 1,000 fakes need 16 TB online at once, and since the minute is secret it must stay warm: at ~$0.005/GB-hr that's $80/hr, about $700k/yr, while an honest agent pays for one box. No bridge can lend RAM to a seat after the window closes. Missed calls dim a seat's opal badge, then halve its vote.
